post.description: POST to the immutable webhook URL configured when the originating key was issued. The URL below is a placeholder, not an API endpoint. HMAC-SHA256 uses the webhook secret over UTF-8 timestamp + '.' + exact raw request bytes. X-Fondeka-Signature is v1=<lowercase hex>. Verify in constant time, reject stale timestamps (recommended ±300s), validate environment and deduplicate event ID before fulfillment. Return any 2xx after durable acceptance. Non-2xx, redirects and transport failures retry up to 10 attempts with 30/60/120/240/480/960/1800/1800/1800-second scheduled delays; scheduling can be later. IDs and payload bytes stay fixed; attempt timestamp/signature change. Revoked credentials still deliver accepted payments. UNKNOWN/MANUAL_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED do not emit terminal events. No ordering guarantee across payments.

BusinessApiError.description: HTTP request error. Branch on HTTP status/errorCode, never message. A payment accepted with 202 reports its financial outcome through the transaction resource/webhook instead.

code.description: Compatibility alias for entitlement errors only.

details.description: Optional structured context; validation errors may include fieldErrors.

status.description: HTTP status, also present as statusCode.

BusinessApiTransactionRequest.description: Fiat-priced collection/payout. Supply paymentMethodName or its legacy ID. Crypto additionally requires a compatible networkName/networkId. Mobile money requires accountRef; all payouts require a destination. Enum membership does not guarantee route/currency/network availability.

accountRef.description: Payer phone for mobile-money collection; recipient phone or crypto address for payout. Phone numbers should use international +country-code format. Optional for crypto collection.

amount.description: Fiat amount in currency, never a literal token amount. EXCLUSIVE requests net; INCLUSIVE requests gross. At most two decimal places.

clientReference.description: Your order/invoice reference, returned in payment resources and webhook data. Not an idempotency key.

currency.description: Three-letter fiat wallet currency, case-insensitive. Availability depends on configured currency and payment route.

feeApplicationMode.description: EXCLUSIVE: amount is net and fees are added. INCLUSIVE: amount is gross and fees are deducted. Null uses the route default; sandbox defaults to EXCLUSIVE.

networkId.description: Legacy database ID; prefer networkName. If both are supplied they must match.

networkName.description: Stable crypto-network enum code. Required for crypto unless networkId is supplied.

paymentMethodId.description: Legacy database ID; prefer paymentMethodName. If both are supplied they must match.

paymentMethodName.description: Stable payment-method enum code. Supply this or paymentMethodId.

BusinessApiTransactionResource.description: Payment state. All money fields except cryptoDetails are fiat values in currency. HTTP acceptance is not financial completion.

amount.description: Quoted net fiat amount, after fees.

businessId.description: Business identified by the authenticated API key.

cryptoDetails.description: Crypto instructions; null for mobile money or while invoice creation is queued. Token amounts are separate from fiat values.

environment.description: Determined by the API key, not the URL.

failureCode.description: Optional sanitized payment failure code. Not an HTTP request error; do not branch on translated messages.

failureMessage.description: Optional displayable failure message; not guaranteed for every provider/outcome.

grossAmount.description: Quoted gross fiat amount including all fees; payout wallet debit.

reference.description: Opaque payment reference used for polling. Preserve exactly; do not infer environment from its format.

refunded.description: Whether the payout debit has been refunded. FAILED/CANCELED alone does not guarantee a refund.

settlementAmount.description: Reconciled gross fiat settlement; may differ from quote for crypto under/overpayment.

settlementNet.description: Reconciled net fiat settlement credited for a completed collection.

status.description: COMPLETED, FAILED and CANCELED are terminal and generate events. UNKNOWN and MANUAL_INTERVENTION_REQUIRED are unresolved: poll/reconcile, do not create another payout.

transactionId.description: Internal financial transaction ID in LIVE; null in SANDBOX. Use reference for this API.

BusinessApiWebhookEvent.description: Terminal payment event. Verify timestamp and HMAC against raw bytes before processing. Deduplicate by id; delivery is at least once.

createdAt.description: Snapshot creation time, not the delivery-attempt timestamp.

environment.description: Must match your expected environment and data.environment.

id.description: Stable event UUID, also sent in X-Fondeka-Event-Id. Unchanged across retries.

Conversion.description: Synthetic sandbox conversion. QUOTED has null id/createdAt and reserves nothing. COMPLETED atomically posts two entries, has an id, and returns both balances. Rate is target units per source unit; amounts are rounded to two decimals.

createdAt.description: Completion time; null for a quote.

feeAmount.description: Source currency fee; currently zero in sandbox.

id.description: Completed conversion ID; null for a quote.

netSourceAmount.description: Source amount after the conversion fee.

rate.description: Synthetic target units per source unit. Display rate may be rounded; targetAmount is authoritative.

status.description: Quotes reserve nothing; completed conversions post atomically.

targetAmount.description: Target units, rounded to two decimals.

amount.description: Amount in source currency, at most two decimal places.

targetCurrency.description: Different fiat currency to credit; pair must have configured sandbox fixtures.

CryptoDetails.description: Crypto invoice/destination instructions. May be null while queued or for mobile money. Token fields are distinct from fiat amounts.

address.description: Crypto collection address or payout destination on the selected network.

amountInCrypto.description: Token quantity to pay/send, not fiat units. Sandbox uses synthetic 1:1 fixtures.

cryptoCurrency.description: Token currency, distinct from the payment's fiat currency.

exchangeRate.description: Fiat units per token in this quote; sandbox is synthetic.

expiresAt.description: Optional crypto invoice expiry; do not pay an expired invoice.

network.description: Crypto network code; must match the destination.

Entry.description: One immutable sandbox ledger entry. Signed amount: positive credit, negative debit. sequence orders entries; paymentReference is null for funding/conversions.

amount.description: Signed amount: credits positive, debits negative.

balanceAfter.description: Wallet balance immediately after this entry.

businessId.description: Business that initiated the operation; the wallet is account-owned.

conversionId.description: Shared conversion ID linking debit and credit, null for other entry kinds.

paymentReference.description: Related sandbox payment reference, null for funding and conversions.

sequence.description: Monotonic ledger sequence used for ordering.

PagedModelEntry.description: Stable page envelope: content holds entries; page holds zero-based number, size and totals.

amount.description: Virtual funding, at most two decimal places. No actual funds are transferred.

currency.description: ISO fiat currency for the virtual wallet.

Business API Key.description: Secret Business-specific credential. Keep server-side. Obtain through the authenticated Business portal.

info.description: Collect and pay out through mobile money and crypto, settling in account fiat wallets. API keys select LIVE or SANDBOX on the same URLs. Merchant endpoints do not use customer JWTs or device sessions. HTTP 202 accepts queued work; only confirmed completion represents a successful payment. Sandbox uses virtual wallets and deterministic fixtures without real providers. The /v1 path is the API major version; info.version versions this documentation contract.
